Title: Azure SQL—General availability updates for late September 2022

Body.Content:
In late September 2022, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Increase the redundancy of your backups with geo zone redundant storage for Azure SQL Managed Instance. 
  • Use the memory optimized premium-series SQL Managed Instance to migrate your larger and more demanding workloads. 
  • Increase resiliency of your Azure SQL Database Hyperscale backups with the new geo-zone redundant storage option.
